selection: same-season, source calendar-end+24h <= decision; exclude exact target fixture
player_identity: Naver playerId, same team and same season only; no name joins or transfers inferred
reference_xi: latest eligible historical XI, never target announced XI
valuation: player goal/assist per nonmissing observed START, from games strictly before reference XI date

features.xi_goal_known_mean: mean historical goal/start over reference XI players with >=1 recorded goal field
features.xi_assist_known_mean: mean historical assist/start over reference XI players with >=1 recorded assist field
features.xi_goal_known_share: fraction of reference XI with observed historical goal/start
features.xi_assist_known_share: fraction of reference XI with observed historical assist/start
features.attack_goal_known_mean: same goal/start mean restricted to reference XI FW/MF; absent group omitted
features.rotation_goal_net: sum entrant goal/start minus sum leaver goal/start, previous -> reference historical XI
features.rotation_assist_net: same assist/start; ALL entrants/leavers must have nonmissing history; no rotation omitted

missing: missing stats remain null; known-subset means carry explicit coverage; no minutes/per90 inference
freshness: omit entire strength bundle when reference XI >30 local calendar days old
publication: unknown historical publication/availability stays retrospective; actual ingestion/fetch time separate
tier: retrospective_lagged (date-only; eligible only under retrospective_date_lagged gate)

network.robots: respect explicit disallow; no inaccessible-site bypass
